info.name: PitchTZ Client API
info.description:
This contract intentionally excludes admin, owner, internal provider-webhook, and payout APIs.
Operations marked `x-pitchtz-status: live` are deployed today. Operations marked `planned`
are the agreed mobile contract and will be implemented without changing their request shape.
All money values are integer Tanzanian shillings and all timestamps are RFC 3339 UTC values.
